collapsible.$description: One region a trigger shows or hides — 'Show all 8 sessions' / 'Show fewer', 'Read more' / 'Show less'. Not Accordion: an Accordion is a list of rows each with its own header; a Collapsible is one hidden part of something, and the part that is always visible is whatever the consumer puts above it (Radix's Collapsible — Accordion is built from them). The trigger IS Button ghost sm (resolved from button.tokens.json) with a trailing chevron that turns over when open, pulled left by its own padding so its text lines up with the content above. The label says what is hidden ('Show all 8 sessions', not 'Show more') and flips to 'Show fewer' / 'Show less'. Hidden content uses hidden="until-found", so find-in-page still reaches it and opens it. Trigger at the bottom when part is already visible and the trigger continues it ('Show all 8 sessions' — the list grows, the trigger moves down with it); trigger on top (.collapsible--trigger-top) when nothing shows until it opens ('Show details' over a block). If the trigger is a section heading ('Advanced options'), it is an Accordion with one row, not this. Added 2026-10-26 — Scheduling had hand-rolled this twice.

clampLines.$description: Read more: the text is cut to this many lines until opened. The trigger only appears when the text is actually longer.
